name: approve_and_render
description: Approve the current script and start paid generation and the final render for every requested aspect ratio. SPENDS CREDITS: pass max_credits (use the number from estimate_cost); the call is refused if the estimate is higher. Refused with blocked_by_rule if check_ad shows blocking findings, unless override_reason is given. Only works while status is 'awaiting_approval'. Poll get_ad_status until 'completed' to get the video URLs.

max_credits.description: Maximum credits you allow this to cost

override_reason.description: Only if check_ad shows 'block' findings you accept. Recorded in the audit log.

idempotency_key.description: Unique string for this request, e.g. a UUID. Repeating a call with the same key and inputs returns the original result and spends nothing extra.

name: cancel_ad
description: Cancel a job that has not finished. Credits held for stages that have not run are released. Safe to repeat.

name: check_ad
description: Check the ad's current script against its brand kit's rules and return findings (severity, rule, quoted text, suggested fix). Free and read-only. Rules with type "semantic" are checked by a model in the background: semantic_status is "pending" until it finishes, "off" if no model is configured, "unavailable" if it failed. Findings are advisory, not legal advice. A 'block' finding stops approve_and_render unless an override_reason is given.

name: create_ad
description: Start a new video ad from a text prompt. Writes the script only (no paid generation) and returns a job_id. Next: poll get_ad_status until status is 'awaiting_approval', review the plan, call estimate_cost, optionally edit the script, then call approve_and_render.

prompt.description: What the ad is for: product, audience, offer, desired feel

idempotency_key.description: Unique string for this request, e.g. a UUID. Repeating a call with the same key and inputs returns the original result and spends nothing extra.

name: create_brand_kit
description: Save a reusable brand kit (logo, colors, font, tone). Returns brand_kit_id to pass to create_ad. Call this once per brand, before create_ad.

logo_url.description: Public https URL of a PNG, JPG or SVG logo

colors.description: Brand colors as hex codes, primary first

name: create_variants
description: Create 1 to 5 alternative versions of an ad that differ from it in exactly one thing: hook, angle, offer, cta or visual_style. Every variant is checked by a deterministic diff against the base ad and rejected if it changes anything else, so results from a later test can be attributed to that one variable. Returns each variant's job_id, the computed diff, and its brand-rule check. Free (text only); the variants then go through the normal estimate_cost, check_ad and approve_and_render steps. Works on an ad that is 'awaiting_approval' or 'completed'. One variant group tests one variable.

tested_variable.description: The one thing that should differ

idempotency_key.description: Unique string for this request, e.g. a UUID. Repeating a call with the same key and inputs returns the original result and spends nothing extra.

name: estimate_cost
description: Show what approve_and_render would cost in credits, broken down by stage, plus your available balance. Free and read-only. Call before approve_and_render and pass the number as max_credits.

name: get_ad_status
description: Get a job's status, progress, current script (scene plan), scene previews, final render URLs and your credit balance. Read-only; safe to poll every few seconds.

name: get_download_url
description: Get a fresh download link for a finished video, using a render_id from get_ad_status. Links expire after about 15 minutes, so call this again whenever you need one. Read-only.

render_id.description: From the renders list in get_ad_status

name: get_storyboard
description: Get a free preview of the ad's timing and captions, scene by scene, before any paid generation. Read-only.

name: list_ads
description: List recent ads and their statuses, newest first.

name: regenerate_scene
description: Re-create the visual and voiceover for one scene using an instruction (e.g. 'show a family instead'). SPENDS CREDITS. Without confirm=true it only returns the estimate. To run it, pass confirm=true and max_credits. Only works while status is 'awaiting_approval'; the job returns to that status when done. Each ad allows a limited number of regenerations.

instruction.description: What to change about this scene

confirm.description: Must be true to spend credits

max_credits.description: Refuse if the estimate is higher than this

idempotency_key.description: Unique string for this request, e.g. a UUID. Repeating a call with the same key and inputs returns the original result and spends nothing extra.

name: set_brand_rules
description: Replace a brand kit's rules. Rule types: banned_phrase, regex, forbidden_claim and required_disclaimer are checked deterministically; semantic rules are plain-language instructions checked by a model (advisory only). Each call saves a new rule-set version. forbidden_claim and required_disclaimer block approval by default. Examples (tone, past winners) guide generation and never block.

pattern.description: Phrase, regex, disclaimer text, or (for semantic rules) a plain-language instruction

severity.description: Defaults: banned_phrase warn, regex warn, forbidden_claim block, required_disclaimer block, semantic warn

name: update_script
description: Edit the hook, call to action, or individual scenes of the script. Only works while status is 'awaiting_approval'. Free. Total scene duration must stay within 1 second of the requested ad length. Each edit creates a new plan version.

scenes.description: Only the scenes you want to change
